title: ASAP: Attention Sink Anchored Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2605.22372v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) face severe computational bottlenecks due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention at high resolutions. Existing token reduction methods rely on local metrics -- such as single-layer attention scores -- that are inherently vulnerable to the attention sink phenomenon, where uninformative tokens are paradoxically preserved over salient foreground objects. We propose ASAP (Attention Sink Anchored Pruning), a training-free framework that recasts this sink as a feature. Modeling ViT information flow as a Lazy Random Walk, ASAP identifies the sink as a dominant accumulator of probability mass. By computing the diffusion distance to the sink within the cumulative transition matrix, ASAP partitions tokens via Radial Diffusion Clustering and compresses background redundancy through Transition Weight Pooling in a single shot. translated_title: ASAP：基于注意力汇聚锚定的剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 视觉 Transformer（ViT）由于高分辨率下自注意力的二次复杂度而面临严重的计算瓶颈。现有的 token 削减方法依赖于局部指标——例如单层注意力分数——这些指标天然容易受到注意力汇聚现象的影响，导致无信息量的 token 反而被保留，而显著的前景目标却被丢弃。我们提出了 ASAP（Attention Sink Anchored Pruning，注意力汇聚锚定剪枝），这是一个无需训练的框架，将这种汇聚现象重新定义为一种特征。通过将 ViT 的信息流建模为惰性随机游走，ASAP 将汇聚点识别为概率质量的主要累积器。通过在累积转移矩阵中计算到汇聚点的扩散距离，ASAP 利用径向扩散聚类对 token 进行划分，并通过转移权重池化一次性压缩背景冗余。在图像、视频和视觉-语言任务上的大量实验证明了 ASAP 的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ASAP 提出了一种无需训练的 ViT token 剪枝框架，将注意力汇聚现象建模为惰性随机游走中的概率累积特征，通过径向扩散聚类与转移权重池化一次性压缩背景冗余 token。
en_tdlr: ASAP is a training-free token pruning framework for Vision Transformers that exploits the attention sink phenomenon by modeling information flow as a Lazy Random Walk, partitioning tokens via Radial Diffusion Clustering and compressing background redundancy through Transition Weight Pooling in a single shot.
